pages.text: The Geothermal Core's interface splits its output and takes permanent upgrades.

pages.title: Output Split
pages.text: Three shares that add up to 100%: $(bold)heat$(), $(bold)oxygen$() and $(bold)power$().$(br2)Default: 60% heat, 40% O2, 0% power.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: Each 1% of power share gives $(bold)0.2 kW$(): 20 kW at 100%.$(br2)Set power first; the heat/O2 slider splits what's left. See $(l:power/basics)Power Basics$(/l).

pages.title: Oxygen
pages.text: 40% O2 supplies $(bold)8$() room units, 20% supplies 4, 0% none.$(br2)Breathing and flames draw first. Only spare production charges reservoirs, canisters, suits and airlocks.

pages.title: Heat Share
pages.text: It scales heat transfer; supply temperature and surface penalty stay. Less heat cools the room gradually.$(br2)The split is saved and never drifts.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: Consumed. No refunds.$(br2)$(bold)Range$(), max 32 blocks$(li)Obsidian: +1$(li)Diamond Block: +4$(br2)$(bold)Temperature$(), max +100°C$(li)Blaze Powder: +5°C$(li)Thermal Core: +10°C

pages.title: Upgrade Effects
pages.text: Temperature upgrades raise supply temperature and output. Range upgrades extend outdoor warmth. O2 upgrades are separate.

pages.title: O2 Upgrade
pages.text: Nether Stars, up to 3 levels. Each adds $(bold)reach, not output$(): 16, 20, 26, 32 blocks.$(br2)$(flavor)We designed this before the Nether collapsed.$()

pages.title: Canister Slot
pages.text: The fourth slot refills an $(l:orsa_equipment/o2_canisters)O2 Canister$(/l) from spare production, shared with reservoirs, EVA refill and airlocks.
